d: Long, flowing deep purple hair with pink highlights at the ends and blunt-cut bangs frames a youthful, teenage face with sharp, golden-yellow eyes. The slim build is dressed in a black and white futuristic outfit consisting of a white chest piece under a black cropped jacket, a black form-fitting bodysuit with a high-cut hip line, and one asymmetrical black thigh-high stocking with a knee pad. Signature details include two pointed cat ears protruding from a black military-style cap, red fingerless gloves, and a long, slender black mechanical tail.
